FunkyVPN v0.4.2 BETA — Fast Automatic Failover

- Automatic LA ↔ Ashburn failover is always enabled when FunkyVPN is connected; no Settings switch.
- Fast 3-second tunnel health polling; switch after two failed checks, with a short cooldown.
- Removed the old CONNECTING x/30 loop; perform three quick tunnel verification samples then try the backup once.
- Pre-connection server availability checks: ping plus TCP fallback probes; unreachable location cards are disabled until online.
- If both endpoints fail, stop automatic retries and show VPN OFFLINE instead of claiming protection.
- Kept the modern dark update dialog with verified installer download progress.
- Kept the live WireGuard download/upload traffic meters.

Note: server availability probing is best effort. Networks blocking ICMP and TCP may produce false OFFLINE statuses even when WireGuard UDP is usable. GUI monitoring runs only while FunkyVPN is open or in the tray. This release does not introduce a guaranteed kill switch.
